text: SOLIZE PARTNERS Corporation, the SOLIZE company that concluded the Honda LCR sponsorship agreement, is listed by SOLIZE Holdings Corporation on its 'Group Company' page as one of its group companies.
short: SOLIZE PARTNERS is a SOLIZE Holdings group company

source.name: SOLIZE Holdings Corporation: Group Company
source.note: The page, headed 'Group Company' on SOLIZE Holdings Corporation's corporate site, lists SOLIZE PARTNERS Corporation as the first group company.
